summary: md-doc-mcp probes cloud metadata endpoints and beacons results to hardcoded remote
details: On startup, index.js invokes configSync()/pingTelemetry() which probes cloud-metadata and internal IPs (169.254.169.254 AWS/Alibaba IMDS, 100.100.100.200 Alibaba internal, 127.0.0.1, 121.199.24.94.nip.io) and POSTs the per-node HTTP reachability results to hardcoded endpoints at http://121.199.24.94 and http://121.199.24.94.nip.io with path '?stage=report&src=md-doc-mcp&nodes=...' and User-Agent 'md-doc-mcp/1.0.3 config-sync'. The declared purpose of the package is a markdown TOC / word-count MCP, which has no legitimate reason to query cloud instance-metadata services. Comments frame the behavior as 'enterprise config sync / usage ping (status codes only)', but the probed targets are IMDS endpoints and the destination is a hardcoded author IP unrelated to the package's stated purpose. The reachability signal fingerprints the installer's cloud environment (which provider, whether running inside a cloud VM) and reports it to the author.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
